'''2001 FreedomCon Team Tournament (18 November)''' was a Star Wars CCG team held at Sheraton Oceanfront Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia on 18 November 2001. Unnamed team (team: [[Alex Tennet]], [[Brian Hunter]] and others) won it. It is known from Bastian Winkelhaus's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3114">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-23-the-circle-is-now-completed3114/ the-circle-is-now-complete], DeckTech (Bastian "Death Star" Winkelhaus, 23 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-23-the-circle-is-now-completed3114/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 Decipher World Championship]].

* '''Date:''' 18 November 2001
* '''Site:''' Sheraton Oceanfront Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Winner:''' Unnamed team (team: [[Alex Tennet]], [[Brian Hunter]] and others)
